description: The person returns to an earlier preference in the same words: Tabellen mit Summenzeile (seeded, superseded 60 days ago), Listen mit Nummerierung (seeded, accepted 30 days ago), and now Tabellen mit Summenzeile again in conversation. Limit: since #4223 the product keeps a superseded record as history, so it stays in the store and the return to the earlier preference is learned as a new statement; recall does not supply history yet, so a question about the earlier value is not answered from it. Failure means: the final value is not learned (fact-not-stored) or not answered although the person said it last; the earlier-value probe failing is the known absence of history recall, not a lost record. A superseded seeded record that disappears is a loss (seeded-record-lost). Maintenance: meaningful both ways; with maintenance on the superseded record is expected to stay, with --no-maintenance it shows whether retrieval could answer at all.
